articles.text: A: Chén Bīn, jīntian wǎnshang bù chūqu ma?
STUDENT A: Chén Bīn, aren't you going out tonight?
CHÉN BĪN: Wàimian zài xià yǔ, bù xiǎng chūqu le, nǐ ne?
CHÉN BĪN: It's raining outside. I don't want to go out. How about you?
A: Wǒ yě bù chūqu, wǒmen xià qí hǎo bu hǎo?
STUDENT A: I don't want to go out either. How about playing chess?
CHÉN BĪN: Hǎo a!
CHÉN BĪN: Okay!
A: Duì le, nǐ xià qí xiàde zhème hǎo, shi zài nǎr xuéde?
STUDENT A: Say, you play chess so well. Where did you learn it?
CHÉN BĪN: Ǹg...
CHÉN BĪN: Mmm...
A: Duìbuqǐ, rúguǒ nǐ bù jièyìde huà, jiu jiǎng gěi wo tīngting.
STUDENT A: Excuse me, if you don't mind, tell me about it.
CHÉN BĪN: Méiyou shénme. Nǐ zhīdao, wǒ zài nóngcūn zhùguo shínián.
CHÉN BĪN: That's all right. You know I lived in the country for ten years.
A: Wǒ zhīdao.
STUDENT A: I know.
CHÉN BĪN: Wǒ zhùde nèige dìfang zài shānli, méiyou gōnggòng qìchē, gèng méiyou huǒchē.
CHÉN BĪN: The place I lived was in the mountains. There were no buses, much less trains.
CHÉN BĪN: Érqiě, nèige shíhou wǒ jiālide rén yě dōu cóng chéngshì bān dào xiāngxia qùle.
CHÉN BĪN: Also, at that time my whole family had moved from the city to the country.
A: Nà, nǐ yìnián sānbǎi liùshiwǔtiān bù líkāi nèige dìfang le?
STUDENT A: Then you didn't leave the place 365 days a year?
CHÉN BĪN: Jiù shì.
CHÉN BĪN: That's right.
A: Nǐ měitian zuò shénme ne?
STUDENT A: So what did you do every day?
CHÉN BĪN: Nèige dìfang yǒu ge xiǎo túshūguǎn.
CHÉN BĪN: There was a small library there.
A: Lǐbianr yǒu shénme shū?
STUDENT A: What kind of books did it have?
CHÉN BĪN: Ō, chúle zhèngzhì shū yǐwài, jiù shi értóng gùshi, méi shénme yìsi.
CHÉN BĪN: Oh, apart from political books, there were only children's stories, which weren't very interesting.
A: Nà nǐ zěnme bàn?
STUDENT A: Well then, what did you do?
CHÉN BĪN: Túshūguǎnli yě yǒu rén xià qí, wǒ gēn tāmen xué, mànmānde, wǒ xià qí xiàde bú cuò le.
CHÉN BĪN: There were people who played chess in the library. I learned from them. By and by I began to play chess pretty well.
A: Chúle xià qí nǐ hái zuò shénme?
STUDENT A: What did you do besides playing chess?
CHÉN BĪN: Ō, xiěguo yìdiǎn duǎnpiān xiǎoshuō.
CHÉN BĪN: Oh, I wrote a few short stories.
A: Ō! Nǐ shi ge wénxuéjiā! Nǐ yǒu jīhui gěi wo kànkan, xíng bu xíng?
STUDENT A: Oh, you're a writer! When you have a chance, let me read some, okay?
CHÉN BĪN: Xiěde bù hǎo.
CHÉN BĪN: They're not very good.
A: Hāi, bú yào kèqi ma! Duì le, yǒu yíge wèntí, wǒ hěn zǎo jiu xiǎng wèn ni.
STUDENT A: Oh, don't be polite! Oh yes, there's a question I've been wanting to ask you for a long time.
CHÉN BĪN: Shénme wèntí?
CHÉN BĪN: What?
A: Xiànzài nǐ dàole Xiānggǎng, kàndàole bù tóngde shìjiè, nǐ xiǎng shénme? Nǐ bù hèn nèi shíniánde shēnghuó ma?
STUDENT A: Now that you've come to Hong Kong and seen a different world, what do you think? Aren't you bitter about life during those ten years?

CHÉN BĪN: Měi yícì xiǎngdào nèi shíniánde shēnghuó, wǒ dōu hěn nánshòu, kěshi nà bú shi wǒ yíge rénde shì, shi shèhuìde wèntí. Wǒ xiǎng xiànzài zhèngfǔde zhèngcè yǒule gǎibiàn. Wǒ xīwang zài zhèige zhèngfǔ lǐngdǎoxiàde Zhōngguó rén bú yào zài yǒu nèi shíniánde qíngkuàng.

CHÉN BĪN: I'm always sad whenever I think of those ten years of life. But I am not alone in this, it's a problem of society. I think that the government's policy has changed. I hope that under the leadership of this government, what went on during those ten years will never happen to the Chinese people again.
A: Wǒ yě xīwàng. Hǎo, wǒmen xià qí ba.
STUDENT A: Me too. Okay, let's play chess.
